description: Authored training parameters. These values are educational game design, not NASA measurements or operational limits.

solar-shelter.limitation: Exposure points and protection factors are qualitative game rules. The DONKI event supplies historical context only.

greenhouse.referencePhotoperiod: 16 hours light and 8 hours dark from NASA OSD-269 metadata; 24-hour training period is an approximation.
greenhouse.limitation: Growth, stress, energy, water, fault, yield and initial maturity are authored and are not measurements of Mars crop performance.

earth-delay.oneWayReference: JPL Horizons Mars/Earth center down-leg time for 2026-11-14; used for both legs as an approximation.
earth-delay.limitation: Processing time, pump faults, repair procedures, air-reserve units, crop-stress mapping and equipment are fictional training assumptions.

thirty-sols-radiation.limitation: Exposure points, crew-condition changes, and the 50-point ready-for-next-task threshold are authored, non-medical game scales. Water and rover shelter strategies have different modeled effects; the exercise never reduces crew condition to zero.

lunar-sunlight.limitation: The two LOLA 5-by-5 pixel samples are separate sites used as analogs, not fictional adjacent pads. Short shadow times, mapping, loads and terrain are authored.

lunar-dust.limitation: The dust quantities, cleaning, filter and air-cycle values are authored. NASA reported an EDS demonstration on rigid glass and radiator surfaces; this is not a whole-suit cleaner.

lunar-relay.oneWayReference: JPL Horizons Moon/Earth center down-leg time, 2026-11-14.
lunar-relay.limitation: The local ridge is a two-dimensional fictional line-of-sight teaching model; it is not a validated radio link budget.
